snippet.title: Souls Divided - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer - New Atmospheric Puzzle Game
snippet.description:
What happens when you split your soul in two to navigate overlapping realities? 
Wishlist Souls Divided on Steam now!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4617510/Souls_Divided/

Step into the astral realm of Namuru, a mysterious world shaped by two opposing forces: Order and Chaos. In this atmospheric, top-down puzzle adventure, you must learn to exist in two places at once. Switch between your physical body and two ethereal forms, manipulating the environment to unlock paths and escape a forgotten civilization. 

Key Gameplay Features:
- One Body, Two Souls, Three Realms: Control multiple forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them to make obstacles disappear or reveal shifting paths.
- The Astral Tether: Your connection is your greatest tool. Pass the energy tether through objects to trigger mechanisms, activate platforms, or break barriers but watch your step, as certain forces can sever it.
- Mind-Bending Mechanics: Combine dual wormholes, astral mirrors, and shifting crystals to solve deeply layered logical puzzles.
- Philosophical Lore: Explore a subtle, mysterious world inspired by dualistic cosmologies, focusing on the fascinating tension between structure and change.

Wishlist on Steam & Request Playtest Access:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4617510/Souls_Divided/

Follow the development journey:
Discord: https://discord.gg/x8tHC5T5rh
